title: Nobody Is Coming To Save You

post.title: Nobody is coming to save you. 🌧️
post.description: Send this to someone who is still waiting for the right moment.
post.pinned_comment: What are you still waiting for? 👇

scenes.narration: Nobody is coming to save you. Not tomorrow. Not next year. Not ever.
You keep waiting for the right moment, the right person, the right sign.
But the world is not cruel. It is simply busy. Everyone is fighting their own war.
Thousands of people walk past you every day, and not one of them is thinking about your dreams.
That sounds cold. It is actually the most freeing thing you will ever hear.
Because if nobody is coming, then nobody is stopping you either.
No permission. No rescue. No one to blame. Just you, and the next step.
The people you admire were never saved. They simply got tired of waiting, and started climbing.
So burn the excuse that someone else will fix your life.
You are the hero you have been waiting for. You always were.
So tell me. How much longer are you going to wait?
